newsitem.title: BELGIUM: UCB to buy cellulose film unit in U.S.
newsitem.headline: UCB to buy cellulose film unit in U.S.

text.p: Belgian chemicals and pharmaceuticals company UCB SA said on Wednesday it would buy a cellulose film production unit from U.S. firm Flexel Inc.

UCB said in a statement it aimed to reach a production capacity of 15,000 tonnes per year by the end of this year at the unit in Tecumseh, Kansas, giving an annual turnover of about 2.5 billion Belgian francs.
UCB gave no financial details of the purchase, which would raise total annual production capacity for films to 110,000 tonnes.
UCB said the use of cellulose film was very important in certain areas of food packaging, mainly for confectionaries and soft cheese, as well as in adhesive tape.
UCB Films Inc., whose administrative and commercial offices are in Atlanta, Georgia, is also distributing polypropylene film and providing sales and technical support for its film products.
